const canonical = (value) => (0,__vite_ssr_import_3__.canonicalizeCompleteJson)(value, {
	maxBytes: 131072,
	maxDepth: 64,
	maxNodes: 2e4
});
const sha = (value) => (0,__vite_ssr_import_0__.createHash)("sha256").update(canonical(value)).digest("hex");
const toyTokens = (value) => Math.ceil(Buffer.byteLength(canonical(value)) / 64);
// The synthetic provider can learn the tool value only through the actual
// ModelRequest. It has no closure access to a fixture output or expected hash.
function readToolResult(value) {
	if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return undefined;
	if (Array.isArray(value)) {
		for (const item of value) {
			const found = readToolResult(item);
			if (found !== undefined) return found;
		}
	} else {
		const record = value;
		if (record.type === "TOOL_RESULT") {
			const payload = record.payload;
			if (payload?.completion === "COMPLETE") return payload.output;
		};
		for (const child of Object.values(record)) {
			const found = readToolResult(child);
			if (found !== undefined) return found;
		}
	};
	return undefined;
}
function deliveredOutput(request) {
	const frame = [request.context];
	for (const message of request.messages) {
		try {
			frame.push(JSON.parse(message.content));
		} catch {}
	};
	return readToolResult(frame);
}
